O.outcome_detail: number of reviewed studies coded by theoretical orientation

cells.quote: Analysis of the 24 reviewed studies reveals a clear dominance of human-centred approaches, with 23 studies explicitly framed within the context of human agency. In contrast, only one study (Walker et al. 2025) reflected a posthumanist orientation.
cells.note: The review states that coding reflected each study's stated theoretical orientation. Educational levels varied across the included studies, and the text describes classroom, online, and technology-mediated contexts.
